method: Branches from the coverage roadmap plus three from Robotics V3. Master skills placed by subdomain, or by id where a subdomain spans branches; V3 entries not in the master placed by planning id. Candidate mappings are reviewed judgements (Task 4). Status: covered = every candidate maps to an existing skill; partial = at least one split or new skill; audit needed = only planning tasks; missing = no existing skills.

branches.name: Number and algebra foundations
branches.boundary: Number, fractions, ratios and percentages, units-free algebra, equations and inequalities, functions, exponents and logarithms, polynomials, sequences, complex numbers, logic.
branches.excludes: Number theory, proof-based algebra and contest techniques with no robotics use.

candidates.outcome: Check duplicate representations across imported math collections
Verify prerequisite paths needed by new engineering skills

remainingEstimate.note: Estimate: each split or new candidate is at least one skill; the roadmap calls its candidates examples, not a complete list, so the high end allows about three skills each.
